10.sourceTitle: Schwalbe Clik Valve | H&S Bike-Discount GmbH
10.evidenceText: Multiple prices found across two sources: bike-discount.de lists prices 33,99€, 11,99€, 3,79€, 9,99€; ebike24.com lists 13,90€, 11,90€, 7,90€, 16,99€, 13,99€, 9,95€. Original RRP prices also documented: 49,99€, 16,95€, 5,95€. Median of all 14 prices is 12,95€.
10.extractionRationale: Extracted all retail prices (both RRP and sale prices) from two German sources selling Schwalbe Clik Valve products. The 14 identified prices were sorted and the median calculated as the average of the 7th and 8th values: (11,99 + 13,90) / 2 = 12,95 EUR. This represents the central price point across all variants and both retailers.

30.extractionRationale: Stock status cannot be determined from the provided text. The page content is not fully rendered - only a JavaScript loading screen is visible. 61.evidenceText: LME Aluminium Alloy Official Prices: Cash 2990.00 / 3000.00 USD/t, 3-month 2990.00 / 3000.00 USD/t (Data valid for 12 Nov 2026)
61.extractionRationale: Extracted from the most recent official LME pricing data (Nov 12, 2026).
